cards.name: Whip Demon
cards.text: Rebirth.
cards.flavor: He cracks the whip, and the line of sinners keeps moving.
cards.art: A horned demon raising a barbed whip over a line of naked sinners on a stony bridge.

cards.name: Thief Serpent
cards.text: Venom.
cards.flavor: It bites the thief, and the thief turns into a snake.
cards.art: A small green serpent coiled around a naked man whose body is merging with its coils.

cards.name: Blood Swimmer
cards.text: Guard. Last Breath: Summon a 1/1 Tormented Shade.
cards.flavor: Those who harmed others are kept in boiling blood up to the eyebrows.
cards.art: The heads and shoulders of sinners rising above the surface of a river of boiling red liquid.

cards.name: Barbed Imp
cards.text: Last Breath: Deal 1 damage to the enemy hero.
cards.flavor: Its hooks tear at whoever touches it, even as it dies.
cards.art: A small red demon with hooked claws clutching a pitchfork on a stony ledge.

cards.name: Hellhound Pup
cards.text: Ward.
cards.flavor: Cerberus has a brood, and every pup bites.
cards.art: A small black hound with glowing red eyes baring its teeth on muddy ground.

cards.name: Calcabrina
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: He cheats, sneers, and runs before anyone can react.
cards.art: A grinning winged demon mid-leap above a narrow stone bridge.

cards.name: Pitch Sinner
cards.text: End of Turn: Deal 1 damage to the enemy hero.
cards.flavor: The pitch sticks to him, and the heat never lets go.
cards.art: A naked sinner coated in black pitch, standing waist-deep in a bubbling tar pit.

cards.name: Barbariccia
cards.text: Guard. On Play: Give a friendly minion +1/+1.
cards.flavor: She hands out orders with a horn, and her squad obeys.
cards.art: A tusked demon blowing a curved horn in a rocky pit, with smaller demons gathered behind it.

cards.name: Farfarello
cards.text: Last Breath: Deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
cards.flavor: Even while dying, he kicks his enemies on the way out.
cards.art: A grinning demon with clawed hands reaching forward, lunging out of a rocky pit.

cards.name: Cagnazzo
cards.text: Drain.
cards.flavor: Every wound he deals feeds him.
cards.art: A fanged demon with a dog-like snout sinking its jaws into a sinner's shoulder.

cards.name: Cacus, the Centaur
cards.text: Swift. Start of Turn: Gain 1 Armor.
cards.flavor: He drags stolen cattle backward so no one can follow the tracks.
cards.art: A hairy centaur dragging a herd of cattle backward into a cave mouth.

cards.name: Draghignazzo
cards.text: Drain. Start of Turn: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He throws his hooks at whoever is nearest, every single turn.
cards.art: A demon with spiked wings and a barbed tail raising a long hooked staff over a pit.

cards.name: Graffiacane
cards.text: Swift.
cards.flavor: He is always the first to leap and the last to be blamed.
cards.art: A demon with a hound-like body and bat wings leaping forward from a rocky ledge.

cards.name: Libicocco
cards.text: Venom.
cards.flavor: Its venom makes every wound burn longer.
cards.art: A grinning demon with a long hooked tail coiled around a stone pillar.

cards.name: Ephialtes, the Giant
cards.text: Guard.
cards.flavor: The well comes only up to his chest.
cards.art: A towering giant with chains on his arms, standing waist-deep in a stone well.

cards.name: Briareus, Hundred-Hand
cards.text: Rebirth.
cards.flavor: A hundred arms and no hand free to hold him back.
cards.art: A giant with many arms reaching up out of a stone well in a crowded pit.

cards.name: Hellhound Guardian
cards.text: Guard. End of Turn: Restore 1 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: Its jaws never stop barking, even when the bones are gone.
cards.art: A massive black hound with a spiked collar standing guard in front of a stone gate, teeth bared.

cards.name: Scarmiglione
cards.text: Drain.
cards.flavor: His grip on the damned is slow, and his hunger is quick.
cards.art: A demon with tangled hair and sharp fangs gripping a sinner by the head.

cards.name: Rubicante, the Flame
cards.text: Ward. End of Turn: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: His fire never goes out, not even in the mud.
cards.art: A demon wreathed in flames, holding a burning whip on a cracked, scorched plain.

cards.name: Antaeus, the Earth-Born
cards.text: Start of Turn: Restore 2 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: Touch the earth, and he rises stronger than before.
cards.art: A giant rising from a rocky plain, one palm pressed flat on the ground beneath him.

cards.name: Malacoda, Chief Demon
cards.text: Venom. On Play: Summon two 1/1 Tormented Shades.
cards.flavor: The chief sends his squad to do the dirty work.
cards.art: A large horned demon with a hooked tail standing above a group of smaller demons on a rocky ledge.

cards.name: Nimrod, the Giant
cards.text: On Play: Deal 2 damage to a minion.
cards.flavor: He built a tower to reach heaven, and now no one understands him.
cards.art: A huge bearded giant with a horn slung over his shoulder, standing among stone ruins.

cards.name: Lucifer, the Frozen King
cards.text: Rebirth. On Play: Freeze all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: Stuck waist-deep in ice, he still freezes anyone who comes near.
cards.art: A colossal three-faced figure with huge bat wings, frozen waist-deep in a sheet of blue ice.

cards.name: Fallen Angel of Dis
cards.text: Ward. On Play: Destroy an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He refused the gate, and nobody gets past him.
cards.art: A fallen angel with tattered grey wings standing before a massive iron gate set in a fiery wall.

cards.name: Burning Rain
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to any target.
cards.flavor: Slow flakes of fire fall on the sand, and they never stop.
cards.art: Slow flakes of fire falling through the air above a plain of gray sand.

cards.name: Serpent's Kiss
cards.text: Silence a minion.
cards.flavor: One bite, and the minion forgets every trick it knew.
cards.art: A green serpent with fangs bared in front of a small armored demon.

cards.name: Cocytus Chill
cards.text: Freeze an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: The lake holds the damned so still they can't even twitch.
cards.art: A frozen lake with a pale figure trapped in the ice up to the chest.

cards.name: Sulphur Vent
cards.text: Gain 2 empty mana crystals.
cards.flavor: The ground breathes out fumes, and the fumes are fuel.
cards.art: Yellow sulphur smoke pouring out of a crack in a rocky ground.

cards.name: Thieves' Bargain
cards.text: Add two Thief Serpents to your hand.
cards.flavor: Steal what you can, and the serpents will steal it back for you.
cards.art: Two small green serpents coiled around a pile of stolen gold coins.

cards.name: Strength of the Earth
cards.text: Restore 3 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: Touch the soil, and the soil gives back what it took.
cards.art: A bare hand pressed flat against cracked clay, with green shoots rising from it.

cards.name: Cacus's Stolen Herd
cards.text: Draw a card. Deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
cards.flavor: He drags the stolen cattle backward, so no one can follow them.
cards.art: Cattle being dragged backward on ropes into a cave mouth.

cards.name: Demon's Lash
cards.text: Return an enemy minion to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: One crack of the whip, and you start the whole way over.
cards.art: A demon's long barbed whip wrapped around a naked sinner's wrists.

cards.name: Rain of Burning Sand
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: The sand falls like snow, and every flake burns.
cards.art: Burning sand falling from a red sky onto a flat desert plain where figures lie under it.

cards.name: Tide of Boiling Blood
cards.text: Deal 4 damage to a minion. Draw a card.
cards.flavor: Anyone who rises too high from the boiling river is pulled back under.
cards.art: A red river of boiling liquid with bubbles rising and a pale hand reaching up from the surface.

cards.name: Winter of Cocytus
cards.text: Freeze all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: The lake freezes solid, and everything in it stops moving.
cards.art: A wide sheet of blue ice with several pale shapes trapped beneath its surface.
